svg.title: /design-system:setup
svg.desc: You run /design-system:setup. It scans the project with the plugin's scan script, and stops with a suggestion to run the audit instead when the project already has token files or a rules document. It reads the plugin's principles, decisions and rubric, asks you only what changes the plan (contexts, seeds, stack, components, fonts), reads the latest documentation of each tool, and presents the plan. Nothing is written before you approve it. Then it writes the token files, the rules document and the build config into the project, generates the palette and computes the derived roles, installs the approved dependencies and runs the build, which writes the generated CSS, and wires the global CSS to it. It proves the result with the plugin's checks and an audit, and hands off to /design-system:harness for the gates. Read the project: 1. You calls setup skill: /design-system:setup. 2. setup skill calls scripts/: scan. 3. scripts/ replies to setup skill: inventory. Only if tokens already exist: 4. setup skill replies to You: run audit instead, refused. 5. setup skill sends to setup skill: rubric, latest docs. Plan, and wait for you: 6. setup skill calls You: what changes the plan?. 7. You replies to setup skill: contexts, seeds, stack. 8. setup skill calls You: the plan. 9. You replies to setup skill: approved. Write and build: 10. setup skill sends to Your project: tokens, DESIGN.md, config. 11. setup skill calls Build: install, build. 12. Build sends to Your project: generated CSS. 13. Build replies to setup skill: built. Prove it: 14. setup skill calls scripts/: run the checks. 15. scripts/ replies to setup skill: all pass. 16. setup skill calls audit skill: /design-system:audit. 17. audit skill replies to setup skill: met, gates missing. 18. setup skill replies to You: next: harness.
